repositoryCheckpoint.interpretation: Counts describe source history and test definitions at the reviewed commit. They are not passing-test or release-readiness counts.

compatibility.progress: Web API and compatibility implementation continued across the source tree.
compatibility.qualificationBoundary: No newer comparable retained WPT run was found; 286 of 286 remains the last narrow measured result.

featureInventory.progress: Between source commits 2fe12e0e8f82 and 99af1539f340, changed files intersected declared implementation paths for 67 of the 68 catalogue rows.
featureInventory.qualificationBoundary: The canonical catalogue recorded no support-state or automation-state promotions. Declared paths overlap and can be broad, so source-path activity is not feature completion or qualification.

media.progress: Work after the retained YouTube milestone covered MSE initialization ordering, GStreamer helper and WebRTC runtime handling, replay and callback re-entrancy, Android media sessions, preservesPitch, and WebCodecs contracts.
media.qualificationBoundary: The retained 14 August YouTube journeys remain the latest bounded playback evidence.

security.progress: Fail-closed bounds, Android origin-and-mode permission checks, cookie partitioning and expiry work, private extension-resource contexts, host-permission scope, and sandbox paths were added or expanded.
security.qualificationBoundary: The complete threat model and process-isolation qualification remain open.

extensions.progress: Manifest V2 runtime, store, and archive paths expanded; actions, context, messaging, ports, storage, and tabs were modularized; receiver-liveness, failure handling, content DOM helpers, downloads, and hot paths were strengthened.
extensions.qualificationBoundary: uBlock Origin 1.73.0 has a bounded package result, not a full-compatibility claim.

performance.progress: Large-page responsiveness, task batching, incremental streamed text, native-input priority, and extension-network deadlines were improved.
performance.qualificationBoundary: Startup, page-load, memory, and long-session baselines have not been published.

releaseEngineering.progress: Source-bound release receipts, artifact, licence and credential validation, and live and offline smoke paths now exist.
releaseEngineering.qualificationBoundary: The package remains unsigned and the latest hosted qualification produced no step-level evidence.

latestHostedQualification.interpretation: The latest main, Galileo static, and pre-alpha workflow jobs ended without running steps, so they provide no fresh passing qualification signal for the reviewed head.
